name: Branch And Financial Institution Identification 6
definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a financial institution or a branch of a financial institution.

FinancialInstitutionIdentification.name: Financial Institution Identification
FinancialInstitutionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

BranchIdentification.name: Branch Identification
BranchIdentification.definition: Identifies a specific branch of a financial institution.||Usage: This component should be used in case the identification information in the financial institution component does not provide identification up to branch level.
